text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just before the Shuka Sho, Line Craft, who 
had been practicing on her own, invited 
Air Messiah to race together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft worried about Air Messiah when 
she slowed down mid-run. Air Messiah 
confessed, "I feel like... I'll never be 
able to catch up to you..."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft told Air Messiah that she had 
grown this strong because of her deep 
admiration for her and her mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wished to carry the torch to someone 
else, just as Air Messiah and her kin had 
done. With those words, Air Messiah 
remembered the strength she had inherited 
from her mother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Finally, the day of the Shuka Sho arrived. 
Line Craft faced Air Messiah, who had cast 
aside all hesitation, and was challenged 
to an all-out showdown.
